verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing's own docs show it creates and sends invoices, issues credit notes for finalized invoices, produces receipts, applies Stripe Tax, and emails invoices and notifications to customers automatically. Branding settings and rendering templates customize the invoice's appearance. The specific compliance elements the story names are not evidenced. Missing for 10: sequential invoice numbering, custom fields, memo/footer fields, explicit compliance documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: Use the Dashboard to adjust or refund finalized invoices with credit notes.
Depending on the invoice status, clicking the button downloads either a PDF of the invoice or a receipt.
Automatically charge your customer's payment method on file, or email them the invoice with or without a link to a payment page.
You can configure Stripe to send email notifications or reminders to your customer
Stripe allows you to customize (as well as preview) email receipts, hosted invoices, invoice PDFs, and so on, in your Branding settings.
On an invoice, Stripe Tax calculates sales tax, VAT, and GST.
